task: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

args.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 500">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="400" height="500" fill="#e8f4f8"/>
  
  <!-- Ground -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="480" rx="180" ry="30" fill="#7cb342"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Rear Wheel -->
  <circle cx="150" cy="380" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="150" cy="380" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#666" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="150" y1="380" x2="150" y2="335" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Front Wheel -->
  <circle cx="250" cy="380" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="250" cy="380" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#666" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="250" y1="380" x2="250" y2="335" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Frame -->
  <path d="M 150 380 L 200 340 L 250 380" fill="none" stroke="#d32f2f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 200 340 L 190 320" fill="none" stroke="#d32f2f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 250 380 L 260 360" fill="none" stroke="#d32f2f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Handlebars -->
  <circle cx="240" cy="280" r="5" fill="#333"/>
  <path d="M 240 280 L 260 270" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Seat -->
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="320" rx="15" ry="8" fill="#5d4037"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Body -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="260" rx="55" ry="45" fill="#ffcc80" stroke="#e6b800" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Head -->
  <circle cx="175" cy="200" r="30" fill="#ffcc80" stroke="#e6b800" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Beak (large pouch) -->
  <path d="M 145 190 Q 175 220 205 190 L 205 160 Q 175 180 145 160 Z" fill="#ffcc80" stroke="#e6b800" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M 145 190 L 135 185 L 145 175" fill="none" stroke="#e6b800" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Eye -->
  <circle cx="175" cy="200" r="3" fill="#000"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Wing -->
  <path d="M 200 260 Q 240 280 250 250 L 250 220 Q 220 240 200 260" fill="#ffcc80" stroke="#e6b800" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Tail -->
  <path d="M 175 295 L 165 310 L 185 310 Z" fill="#ffcc80" stroke="#e6b800" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Legs -->
  <path d="M 175 305 L 160 340" fill="none" stroke="#ff9800" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 225 305 L 240 340" fill="none" stroke="#ff9800" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="160" cy="340" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#ff9800"/>
  <ellipse cx="240" cy="340" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#ff9800"/>
  
  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="160" y="40" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333">Pelican Cyclist</text>
</svg>
